Inmate Christa Pike Conscious After Botched Execution Attempt

Christa Pike, an inmate, is awake and conscious following a failed execution attempt. Her lawyers stated she is speaking and has been moved to a hospital. A doctor had previously warned Pike's lawyers that the execution method could be cruel and painful.
